subject: biology-1
question: For every three turns of the **Calvin cycle**, which of the following best describes what is consumed and produced?

options.text: Three ATP and three NADPH are consumed, and three G3P molecules are released.
Two G3P molecules are consumed to build glucose, and nine ATP are produced.
Carbon dioxide is consumed and oxygen is released as the main product.
Three CO2 molecules are fixed using nine ATP and six NADPH, yielding one net G3P.

explanation: Each turn fixes one carbon dioxide and consumes three ATP and two NADPH, so three turns consume nine ATP and six NADPH and release one net G3P. A miscounts the ATP and reports three G3P instead of one net. B reverses consumption and production, since G3P is produced, not consumed, and ATP is consumed, not produced. C describes cellular respiration, while oxygen is released in the light reactions, not the Calvin cycle.
